Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<files>

<files> specifies the name of the operating system file(s) within which this markup component is declared.
Attributes (In addition to global attributes)
names supplies the names of one or more files.
Datatype: CDATA
Values: a file identifier
Default: #IMPLIED
Example 
<files names="TEIDICT2"/>
Module Declared in file teitsd2; Auxiliary DTD for Tag Set documentation
Data Description Empty element.
May occur within
Declaration 
<!ELEMENT files %om.RO; EMPTY> 
<!ATTLIST files  
      %a.global;
      names CDATA #IMPLIED>
See further 27.1 The TagDoc Documentation Element
